producer_report.summary:
I recorded OLY-B-NOTE-01's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml and added a test. The mechanism is the existing `specialization` figure, and the measure ends `status: specialization`. The new `routing_evidence.rs` has two tests. One seeds a class with 3 high-effort jobs that all land against 4 medium-effort jobs that all fail, and expects the block to flag high as helping. The other seeds 2 high-effort jobs and expects no flag. Both pass.

`athena status --snapshot` did not print the specialization block, so I added a `specialization` field to `SnapshotView` in `snapshot.rs` and made `snapshot_status` print it. On the real evidence snapshot the block now lists seven classes: build, code, config, design, docs, prompts and tests. Its per-setting counts sum to 767 jobs. I did not count the producer invocations separately to compare. The three settings flagged as helping have 193, 3 and 7 jobs.

I also added the new test file to `xtask/shard-timings.txt` and an entry to `CHANGELOG.md`. `planning.rs` is unchanged. I did not run the new test with the specialization call or its display removed to watch it fail.

The athena-cli tests, the targeted athena-core tests, clippy and the xtask policy scan all pass. I did not run the full `cargo test` for the whole workspace.

This is the first of those two tests, which fails if the block or the flag is missing."

checks_run.command: cargo test -p athena-core -- status snapshot spec

criteria_check.criterion: In docs/spec.toml, requirement OLY-B-NOTE-01 has a mechanism that is no longer "none" and names crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (`specialization`) and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, both of which exist (Grep for the names); its owner stays Athena; its measure says how it is shown and ends with `status: specialization`, a heading line that display.rs prints in `athena status`.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited docs/spec.toml entry; owner Athena; measure ends `status: specialization` (label already in STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS); display.rs specialization_lines prints line starting `specialization `. Ran athena-core status/spec tests and xtask policy: pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a new test (for example in crates/athena-cli/tests/routing_evidence.rs) builds fixture records where a non-baseline producer model/effort has at least SPECIALIZATION_MIN_JOBS jobs and a higher landed share, and asserts the status text prints the `specialization` line with that setting flagged as helping. The test fails if the specialization call or its display is removed, and passes with it.
criteria_check.evidence: routing_evidence.rs: status_flags_a_producer_setting_that_lands_more_once_it_has_enough_jobs asserts the `specialization ` line and 'code: specialization helps: m · high beat the default'; a second test asserts no flag at 2 jobs. Ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --test routing_evidence`: 2 pass. I did not run it against the source with the call removed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>` on the real records: the `specialization` block lists each class of work, and its per-setting job counts sum to the number of dispatched request jobs with a producer invocation. The expected range comes from counting those jobs in history.json and the recorded invocations, a source the change does not compute. Any class flagged as helping has at least 3 jobs in that setting.
criteria_check.evidence: Snapshot status did not print the block, so SnapshotView got a `specialization` field and snapshot_status prints it. Ran the command: classes build, code, config, design, docs, prompts, tests; per-setting counts sum to 767 (5+559+38+50+58+31+26). I did not count them independently from the invocation records. Helping settings: code high 193, prompts haiku 3, tests unrecorded 7 jobs, all at least 3.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`: all pass, including the existing planning and display tests and the records validation tests.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt, clippy --locked -D warnings (clean), whole athena-cli tests, athena-core status/snapshot/spec tests and xtask policy: all passed.

criteria_check.criterion: The figure modules keep their present behavior: the diff to crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs, if any, adds no change to the landing time, throughput, keep rule or planning cost figures. The deliverables are only the files listed.
criteria_check.evidence: planning.rs is unchanged. Two files outside the list changed: crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs (one field, one call) and xtask/shard-timings.txt (one line for the new test file).

open_issues: snapshot.rs and xtask/shard-timings.txt are outside the listed deliverables. Both were needed: the snapshot field so the real-records criterion can show the block, and the timings line because a new test file needs one.
I did not run the new test against a tree with the specialization call or display removed, so "fails without the mechanism" is not shown by a run.
mistakes: My first fixture outcome had no totals, so the helping assertion failed. I fixed it.
learnings: `athena status --snapshot` did not print the specialization block before this change.
A Landed outcome fixture needs `totals`, otherwise the record is reported invalid and the job shows as interrupted.
